blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video diffusion models have learned rich 3D/4D priors, making them promising for scene generation and video re-rendering. However, their use in spatial tasks is limited by imprecise camera control, spatial and temporal inconsistencies, and entangled camera motion with scene dynamics. Existing approaches, such as task-specific fine-tuning and post-process warping, often introduce visual artifacts, generalize poorly, or incur high computational costs. We propose WorldForge V2 to achieve accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. We first develop a training-free guidance framework using warped references to iteratively refine generation along a target camera path. Optical-flow analysis identifies motion-related latent channels for selective guidance, helping separate motion control from appearance. A dual-path strategy further compares guided and unguided predictions to correct artifacts from imperfect references. Together, these components guide viewpoint changes while preserving scene appearance and object motion. To reduce refinement costs, v-cache approximates the correction using the preceding denoising prediction, avoiding an additional model evaluation. We further extend motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and introduce Trajectory LoRA, which concentrates adaptation on blocks most responsive to trajectory guidance. A two-stage training strategy teaches these adapters to denoise the states encountered during guided generation, using limited supervision effectively. This enables reliable camera control with very little training data, with a single training scene already supporting generalization to unseen scenes. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模式已经学会了丰富的3D/4D前科,使得这些模式对场景生成和视频重播充满希望. 然而,它们在空间任务中的使用受到摄影控制不准确、空间和时间不一致以及镜头运动与场景动态缠绕的限制。 现有方法,如针对特定任务的微调和过程后扭曲,往往引入视觉文物,概括性差,或产生高昂的计算成本. 我们提议WorldForge V2实现准确的相机控制,同时保留预先训练的视频模型的基因能力. 我们首先开发一个无培训指导框架,使用扭曲的参考,沿目标相机路径反复精炼一代。 光电流分析确定了选择性引导的与运动相关的潜在通道,有助于将运动控制与外观分离. 双向战略进一步比较有指导性和无指导性的预测,以纠正不完美的参考文献中的文物。 这些组件共同指导视角变化,同时保留场景外观和物体运动. 为降低精细化成本,v-cache使用之前的去名预测来对校正进行近似,避免了额外的模型评价. 我们进一步将运动局部化从潜在通道扩展到网络块,并引入了Trapriotory LORA,它把适应力集中在对轨迹引导最敏感的块上. 一项分两个阶段的培训战略教导这些适配者利用有限的监督,揭穿在制导生成过程中遇到的状态。 这使得可以使用很少的训练数据进行可靠的照相机控制,一个单一的训练场景已经支持了对看不见的场景的泛化. 跨多个数据集的定量和定性评价显示,我们的方法在相机控制的视频生成中实现了最先进的生成质量和轨迹精度.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Comparison with existing methods. With limited training data and iterations, our method achieves state-of-the-art visual quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:与现有方法的比较。 由于培训数据和迭代有限,我们的方法在相机控制的视频生成中实现了最先进的视觉质量和轨迹精度.

blocks.en: Recent video diffusion models (VDMs) can synthesize videos with coherent motion, consistent scene content, and plausible viewpoint changes over time [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Trained on large-scale video data, these models acquire strong spatiotemporal priors, making them powerful backbones for spatial-intelligence tasks such as 3D/4D generation, video re-rendering, and world modeling [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . In these applications, the camera trajectory determines how a scene is observed over time, which regions become visible, and how viewpoint changes relate to scene geometry. Effective trajectory control is therefore essential. The generated video should follow a specified camera path while preserving scene content, object motion, temporal coherence, and visual quality.
blocks.zh: 近期的视频传播模型(VDMs)可以将视频合成出一致的动作,一致的场景内容,以及可能的观点随着时间的变化[1,2,3]. 这些模型在大规模视频数据方面接受了培训,获得了强大的spatiotepress,成为了3D/4D生成,视频重播等空间-智能任务的强大骨干,以及世界建模[4,5,6,7,8,9,10,11]. 在这些应用中,相机轨迹决定了一个场景如何随时间而被观察到,哪个区域变得能被看到,观点的变化如何与场景几何关系. 因此,有效的轨迹控制至关重要。 生成的视频应当遵循指定的相机路径,同时保留场景内容,物体运动,时间一致性和视觉质量.

blocks.en: To realize such control, existing approaches broadly follow two directions. One direction adapts VDMs for camera control through additional trainable modules, pose-aware conditioning interfaces, or model fine-tuning [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 5 , 16 ] . These methods provide explicit camera control but often require large-scale trajectory–video supervision or careful fine-tuning. With limited supervision, such adaptation may weaken the visual and temporal priors of the pretrained model. Recent work has therefore explored training-free alternatives that keep the pretrained VDM fixed and inject trajectory cues only during inference [ 6 , 17 ] , including the zero-shot variant of Warp-as-History [ 18 ] . A representative route is warping-and-repainting , which warps already observed content along the target camera path and uses the pretrained video model to synthesize newly revealed regions. This route enables direct camera control at inference time while preserving the pretrained model, making it well suited to downstream spatial-intelligence tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这种控制,现有办法大致遵循两个方向。 一个方向通过额外的可受训练模块,姿势-知能调节接口,或模型微调[12,13,14,15,5,16]来调整相机控制的VDM. 这些方法提供了明确的相机控制,但往往需要大规模的轨迹-视频监督或仔细的微调. 由于监督有限,这种适应可能削弱预先训练过的模型的视觉和时间前科。 因此,最近的工作探索了在推论[6, 17]中保持预先训练的VDM固定并注入轨迹提示的无培训替代品,包括Warp-as-History [18]的零发取变体. 一个具有代表性的路线是warping-and-repainting ,Warps已经沿着目标相机路径观测到内容,并使用经过预先训练的视频模型来合成出新揭示的区域. 这种路由可以在推断时直接进行相机控制,同时保留了预先训练的模型,使其非常适合下游空间-情报任务.

blocks.en: Despite these advantages, warping-and-repainting can introduce a denoising-state mismatch during diffusion sampling. When warped visible regions are directly combined with model-generated regions in a noisy latent, the two parts may correspond to different noise states. The warped regions are associated with externally sampled noise, whereas the generated regions follow the model’s own denoising trajectory. We refer to this mismatch as a denoising-state domain gap . It can lead to boundary discontinuities, geometric artifacts, noisy patches, and texture degradation. The key challenge is therefore to inject useful trajectory evidence from warped references while reducing the denoising-state gap introduced by their fusion.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些优点,在扩散取样过程中,打磨和再油漆可能会造成去诺氏状态不匹配. 当被扭曲的可见区域与模型产生的区域直接结合在噪音潜伏中时,这两个部分可能与不同的噪音状态对应. 被扭曲区域与外部取样的噪音有关,而产生的区域遵循模型本身的去名轨迹。 我们把这种不匹配称为去诺-状态域间隙。 它会导致边界断裂,几何文物,吵闹的补丁和纹理退化. 因此,关键的挑战是如何从被扭曲的参考文献中注入有用的轨迹证据,同时减少其聚变带来的去诺能状态差距。

blocks.en:
To address this problem, we propose WorldForge V2 , a camera-trajectory-control framework that helps VDMs use imperfect warped trajectory signals more effectively while preserving generation quality.
WorldForge V2 follows the warping-and-repainting route.
First, it addresses the incompatibility introduced by warped-reference fusion: direct fusion in noisy latents mixes externally noised warped regions with generated regions following the model’s current denoising state.
WorldForge V2 reduces this mismatch by fusing the warped reference into the model-predicted clean estimate and mapping the fused result back to the current denoising state, enabling training-free trajectory-aligned video generation.
Second, clean-estimate fusion provides a reliable way to inject warped references into the denoising process by reducing noisy-state mismatch.
To further improve its sampling efficiency, we introduce v-cache, which approximates the clean-estimate correction directly in noisy latents.
In this way, warped-reference guidance can retain the benefit of clean-estimate fusion while reducing the extra sampling overhead.
Finally, full-model fine-tuning and large trainable control modules involve optimizing a large number of parameters, making it difficult to use limited training data efficiently. To address this problem, we build on our pipeline and further investigate an optimization-based approach to camera-trajectory control. Since different layers in VDMs specialize in different functions, we extend the motion-channel localization used in FLF to model adaptation. We identify trajectory-sensitive blocks and apply LoRA only to these blocks. This selective adaptation provides a data-efficient alternative to broad model tuning.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这个问题,我们提出WorldForge V2,一个相机-导管-控制框架,帮助VDM在保存生成质量的同时,更有效地使用不完善的扭曲轨迹信号.
WorldForge V2遵循了打磨再油漆的路线.
首先,它解决了扭曲参照聚变带来的不相容性:在吵闹的潜伏中直接聚变将外部被点名的扭曲区域与模型当前去诺状态下产生的区域相混合。
WorldForge V2通过将被扭曲的参考物放入模型预想的清洁估计中并将被熔接的结果映射回目前的去诺状态来减少这种不匹配现象,使训练无轨相通的视频生成成为可能.
第二,清洁估计聚变通过减少噪音状态不匹配,为向去诺化过程中注入扭曲的引用提供了可靠的方式.
为了进一步提高采样效率,我们引入了v-cache,它直接接近于噪音潜伏物中的清洁估计修正.
这样,被扭曲的参考指导可以保留清洁估计聚变的好处,同时减少额外的采样间接费用.
最后,全模微调和大型可训练控制模块涉及优化大量参数,使得有限的培训数据难以被高效地使用. 为了解决这个问题,我们利用我们的管道,进一步调查对相机-弹道控制采取的优化办法。 由于VDMs中不同的层专门从事不同的功能,我们扩展了FLF中使用的运动通道局部化,以模型化适应. 我们找出对轨迹敏感的区块,并将LORA仅适用于这些区块. 这种有选择的适应为大模型调制提供了有数据效率的替代品.

blocks.en:
First, we address the denoising-state incompatibility caused by warped-reference fusion. In direct noisy-space fusion, the warped visible regions and the model-generated regions may follow different denoising states, causing geometric artifacts, boundary discontinuities, and noisy patches. To mitigate this mismatch, Intra-Step Recursive Refinement (IRR) fuses the warped reference with the model-predicted clean estimate under the visibility mask and then re-noises the fused estimate to the current timestep. This fuse-then-renoise process associates all regions with the same Gaussian noise realization, thereby reducing their denoising-state gap.
Camera-trajectory control also faces a typical motion–appearance disentanglement problem, as enforcing camera motion may inadvertently alter object and scene appearance. To address this problem, Flow-Gated Latent Fusion (FLF) uses optical-flow cues to locate channels that are highly correlated with motion and injects trajectory guidance only into these channels, thereby reducing appearance distortion.
Finally, artifacts or misalignment in the warped reference may degrade the quality of the generated video. To mitigate this issue, we propose Dual-Path Self-Corrective Guidance (DSG). Inspired by classifier-free guidance [ 19 ] , DSG compares the trajectory-guided and unguided denoising directions. Their difference captures the update introduced by trajectory guidance, which DSG uses to suppress unreliable deviations while retaining useful trajectory constraints. Together, IRR, FLF, and DSG enable training-free trajectory-aligned video generation while reducing the adverse effects of incompatible denoising states and unreliable reference signals.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们处理被扭曲的参考核聚变造成的去诺能状态不相容问题。 在直接的噪音空间聚变中,被扭曲的可见区域和模型生成的区域可能遵循不同的去诺状态,导致几何文物,边界不连续,并引起噪音补丁. 为了缓解这种不匹配,Intra-Step Recursive Finement(IRR)在能见度口罩下将被扭曲的参考值与模型预想的清洁估计值相接而成,再将被保险的估计值重新发出到目前的时间步. 这种当时的引信再现过程将所有区域都与同样的高斯噪音实现联系起来,从而缩小了它们的去诺-状态差距.
相机-弹射控制还面临典型的动作-出现分解问题,因为强制相机运动可能会无意中改变物体和场景外观. 为了解决这一问题,Flow-Gated Latent Fusion(FLF)使用光学流出提示来定位与运动高度相通的通道,并仅将轨迹引导注入这些通道,从而减少外观扭曲.
最后,被扭曲的参考文献中的文物或错配可能会降低所生成视频的质量. 为了缓解这一问题,我们提出了双版自译自审指南。 在无分级制导[19]的启发下,DSG比较了轨迹制导和无制导去诺方向. 它们的差异捕捉了由轨迹向导所引入的更新,DSG用来抑制不可靠的偏差,同时保留了有用的轨迹限制. IRR、FLF和DSG共同促成无轨迹相通的视频生成,同时减少不兼容的去诺状态和不可靠的参考信号的不利影响。

blocks.en: Second, the fuse-then-renoise process in IRR provides an effective way to reduce the denoising-state gap introduced by warped-reference fusion. We further improve the efficiency of this process with v-cache. Our key observation is that the correction induced by clean-estimate fusion can be approximated directly in noisy latent space from a denoising prediction already available during sampling. Based on this observation, v-cache applies the approximated correction during warped-reference fusion, allowing trajectory guidance to remain on the original denoising path. This avoids an additional model evaluation and reduces inference latency.
blocks.zh: 第二,IRR中的引信 -- -- 当时的 -- -- 发光过程为减少误入引子聚变带来的去诺能状态差距提供了有效途径。 我们通过v-cache进一步提高这一进程的效率。 我们的主要观察是,从取样时已有的去名预测来看,由清洁估计聚变引起的校正可以直接从噪音的潜在空间中取出近似值。 基于这种观察,v-cache在被扭曲的参考聚变时应用了相近的校正,使轨迹引导能留在原来的去诺路径上. 这避免了额外的模型评价并减少了推论延迟.

blocks.en: Finally, we further develop an optimization-based extension of our pipeline for camera-trajectory control. Existing optimization-based methods often fine-tune the full model or introduce large trainable control modules, making inefficient use of limited supervision. Since camera control mainly depends on motion-related representations, we extend the motion-channel localization idea of FLF to model adaptation. Leveraging the functional specialization of different VDM layers [ 20 ] , we identify trajectory-sensitive blocks, apply LoRA only to these blocks, and train the adapters with a two-stage optimization strategy tailored to our pipeline. This selective adaptation provides a data-efficient alternative to broad model tuning. In our experiments, we find that training data from a single scene is sufficient to enable effective trajectory following.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们进一步发展以优化为基础的扩大我们用于相机-导管控制的管道。 以优化为基础的现有方法往往会微调出完整的模型或引入大型可训练控制模块,对有限的监管使用效率低下. 由于相机控制主要依赖于与运动相关的表现,所以我们扩展了FLF的运动-通道局部化理念来进行模型改造. 利用不同VDM层的功能专业化[20],我们识别出对轨迹敏感的区块,将LORA仅适用于这些区块,并用适合我们管道的两相优化策略对适配器进行培训. 这种有选择的适应为大模型调制提供了有数据效率的替代品. 在我们的实验中,我们发现,从单一场景得到的培训数据足以使有效的轨迹得以遵循。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • To address denoising-state mismatch, motion–appearance entanglement, and unreliable warped references, we develop a training-free guidance pipeline with IRR, FLF, and DSG, enabling trajectory-aligned video generation with fewer artifacts and less appearance distortion. • To retain the benefit of clean-estimate correction with lower sampling cost, we introduce v-cache, which approximates the correction in noisy latent space and avoids an additional model evaluation, thereby reducing inference latency. • To avoid data-inefficient full-model tuning, we identify trajectory-sensitive blocks, adapt only these blocks with LoRA, and optimize them using a two-stage strategy tailored to our pipeline; training data from a single scene is sufficient to enable effective trajectory following. • Comparative experiments on multiple public datasets demonstrate accurate camera-path control and high-quality video generation.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 为了解决去诺能状态不匹配、运动-出现纠缠和不可靠的扭曲参考,我们开发了无培训指导管道,与IRR、FLF和DSG合作,使轨迹相通的视频生成能够减少文物和外观扭曲。 为了保留清洁估计修正的好处并降低采样成本,我们引入了v-cache,它大致反映了噪音潜在空间的纠正,并避免了额外的模型评价,从而降低了推论的延迟性. • 为了避免数据效率不高的全模型调试,我们确定对轨迹敏感的区块,仅用LORA来调整这些区块,并使用适合我们管道的两阶段战略优化这些区块;单一场景的培训数据足以使有效轨迹得以遵循。 • 对多个公共数据集的比较试验显示,摄像机路径控制准确,视频生成质量高。

Fig. 2: Overview of WorldForge V2. Given a single image or video frame and a target camera trajectory, the scene geometry is reconstructed and rendered into trajectory-aligned warped frames.
WorldForge V2 first performs training-free trajectory guidance in the predicted clean latent space using IRR, FLF, and DSG.
Building on this framework, we further introduce an efficient route that directly fuses trajectory information in the noisy latent space with V-Cache, together with a trajectory-sensitive lightweight LoRA scheme for camera trajectory control using only limited training data.
The resulting video follows the specified camera path while preserving the generative capability of the pretrained video diffusion model.
blocks.zh:
发相. 2:世界Forge V2概览. 鉴于一个单一的图像或视频框以及目标相机轨迹,场景几何被重建并制成轨迹相通的扭曲相框.
WorldForge V2首先利用IRR、FLF和DSG在所预测的清洁潜入空间中执行无训练轨迹指导。
在这个框架的基础上,我们进一步引入了一条高效的路线,直接将扰动下潜空间的轨迹信息与V-Cache相接,同时采用轨迹敏感的轻量级LORA计划,仅利用有限的训练数据进行相机轨迹控制.
由此产生的视频遵循了指定的相机路径,同时保留了被预先训练的视频传播模型的分基因能力.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: We review four lines of work closely related to WorldForge V2: video diffusion priors for spatial generation, camera control in video diffusion models, guidance and correction strategies in generative models, and parameter-efficient adaptation for camera control.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了与WorldForge V2:空间生成的视频传播前科、视频传播模型中的相机控制、基因模型中的取向和校正策略以及相机控制的参数效率改造密切相关的四行工作。

blocks.en: II-A Video Diffusion Priors for Spatial Generation
blocks.zh: II-A 空间世代的视频传播历程

blocks.en: Video diffusion models (VDMs) learn rich priors of real-world appearance, motion, temporal continuity, and viewpoint change from large-scale video data [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 22 ] . Recent studies have transferred these priors to spatial generation tasks, including 3D/4D scene generation, novel-view video synthesis, and world modeling [ 23 , 24 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 14 , 25 , 8 , 10 , 9 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . This scene-level use of video priors complements explicit scene reconstruction based on NeRFs, Gaussian splatting, multi-view and light-field synthesis [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] , as well as scene generation from panoramic images [ 38 ] and object-centric 3D generation based on diffusion models [ 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] . While reconstruction methods recover scene structure from observed views, VDMs can use their learned priors to generate plausible content beyond the observed regions. However, VDM pretraining does not explicitly align camera trajectories with scene content. As a result, these models can generate high-quality videos but cannot reliably follow a prescribed camera path, motivating growing research on trajectory-controlled video generation. WorldForge V2 combines warped geometric evidence with the generative prior of a pretrained VDM to control viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模型(VDMs)从大规模视频数据中学习出丰富的真实世界外观,运动,时间连续性,观点变化[1,2,3,22]. 最近的研究将这些前科转移到了空间生成任务,包括3D/4D场景生成,小说-取景视频合成,以及世界建模[23,24,4,5,6,14,25,8,10,9,26,27,28,29,30]. 这种场景层面对视频前传的使用,补充了基于NERFs,高斯克平板,多视和光场合成的清晰场景重建[31,32,33,34,35,36,37],以及基于传播模型的场景生成[38]和以物体为中心的3D生成[39,40,41,42,43]. 虽然重建方法从观测到的观点中恢复了场景结构,但VDM可以利用所学的前科,在观测到的区域之外产生可信的内容. 然而,VDM预训并没有明确地将相机轨迹与场景内容相统一. 因此,这些模型可以产生出高质量的视频,但不能可靠地遵循规定的相机路径,激发了越来越多的对轨迹控制的视频生成的研究. 世界 Forge V2将被扭曲的几何证据与先被训练的VDM之前的基因结合来控制视角变化.

blocks.en: II-B Camera Control in Video Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 视频传播模型中的相机控制

blocks.en: Existing camera-control methods broadly follow two directions. Training-based methods introduce pose-aware conditioning interfaces, additional control modules, or model fine-tuning to learn camera-controlled generation [ 12 , 13 , 15 , 14 , 5 , 44 , 16 , 45 ] . These methods provide explicit camera control but usually require substantial trajectory–video supervision; when training data are limited, model adaptation may weaken the visual and temporal priors learned during pretraining. Recent work has therefore increasingly explored training-free inference-time control and lightweight adaptation, which preserve most or all of the pretrained model and inject trajectory cues through initial noise, latent transformations, rendered references, or history frames [ 8 , 6 , 17 , 46 , 47 , 18 , 48 ] . Across training-based and training-free methods, warping-and-repainting warps observed content along the target camera path and uses a VDM to generate newly revealed regions [ 49 , 50 ] . This route provides explicit geometric correspondence and integrates naturally with depth estimation, point-based rendering, and visibility masks. WorldForge V2 adopts this route and studies how warped references can be used more effectively for camera-trajectory control while reducing the artifacts introduced during denoising. Related motion-control work also uses entity-specific 3D trajectories to control object motion [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh: 现有的相机控制方法大致遵循两个方向. 基于培训的方法引入了姿势感知调节接口,附加控制模块,或模型微调来学习相机控制生成[12,13,15,14,5,44,16,45]. 这些方法提供了明确的相机控制,但通常需要大量的轨迹-视频监督;在培训数据有限时,模型适应可能会削弱在预训期间学到的视觉和时间前科。 因此,最近的工作越来越多地探索了无培训推断时间控制和轻量级适应,这保存了大部分或全部预先训练的模型,并通过初始噪音、潜在转变、参考或历史框架注入了轨迹提示[8、6、17、46、47、18、48]。 纵观基于培训和无培训的方法,在目标相机路径上观测到打磨和再油漆的瓦片内容,并使用VDM生成出新发现的区域[49,50]. 这个路线提供明显的几何通信,并自然地与深度估计,点基渲染,能见度口罩相融合. 世界 Forge V2采用这一途径并研究如何更有效地将被扭曲的引用用于相机-导管控制,同时减少去诺音时引入的文物. 相關的動能控制活性也使用实体特有3D轨迹来控制物体运动 [51].

blocks.en: II-C Guidance and Correction Strategies in Generative Models
blocks.zh: II-C 基因模型的指导和校正战略

blocks.en: Guidance methods steer diffusion or flow models toward desired outputs by modifying their sampling directions. Classifier-free guidance (CFG) combines conditional and unconditional predictions to improve alignment with semantic conditions [ 19 ] . Subsequent methods further adjust the guidance direction through negative or auxiliary branches, differential predictions, adaptive rescaling, resampling, and iterative repainting [ 52 , 53 , 54 , 55 , 56 , 57 , 58 ] . In 3D/4D generation, guidance is also widely used to enforce viewpoint consistency from rendered or warped observations [ 59 , 60 , 6 , 17 , 8 ] . However, conventional guidance does not directly address the artifacts introduced by noisy warped references. WorldForge V2 explores correction strategies for warping-guided generation, including correcting warped-reference fusion in noisy latent space and using the difference between guided and unguided predictions to refine the denoising process. Together, these strategies improve the quality of trajectory-controlled videos generated under warping guidance.
blocks.zh: 指导方法通过修改取样方向,引导传播或流动模型向预期产出方向发展。 无分级制导(CFG)结合了有条件和无条件的预测,以更好地与语义条件相配合 [19]. 后期方法通过负或辅助分支,差分预测,适应性回升,再生,迭代再生等方法来进一步调整取向[52,53,54,55,56,57,58]. 在3D/4D生成中,指南还被广泛用于从提供或扭曲的观测结果中强制执行观点一致性[59、60、6、17、8]。 然而,常规指导并不直接涉及由吵闹的曲折引用引入的文物. 世界 Forge V2探索了向导生成的校正策略,包括在吵闹的潜在空间中纠正向导核聚变,并用向导和非向导预测的区别来完善去诺过程. 这些战略共同提高了在平分制导下产生的轨迹控制视频的质量.

blocks.en: II-D Parameter-Efficient Adaptation for Camera Control
blocks.zh: II-D 相机控制参数有效适应

blocks.en: Model adaptation commonly uses trainable control branches or parameter-efficient fine-tuning. ControlNet and T2I-Adapter introduce lightweight conditioning modules, while LoRA adapts pretrained models through low-rank parameter updates [ 61 , 62 , 63 ] . These lightweight adaptation strategies have also been applied to motion learning, sparse-view synthesis, and trajectory-controlled generation with limited training data [ 64 , 65 , 18 , 45 ] . Related studies further show that motion- and camera-related representations are concentrated in particular latent channels or network layers [ 20 , 66 ] . Based on these findings, WorldForge V2 uses optical-flow cues in FLF to localize motion-related latent channels and reduce appearance interference. We further extend this idea to model adaptation by identifying trajectory-sensitive blocks and applying lightweight LoRA only to these blocks, enabling effective trajectory alignment with very limited training data.
blocks.zh: 模型改造通常使用可训练控制分支或参数效率高的微调. ControlNet和T2I-Adapter引入了轻量级调制模块,而LORA则通过低等参数更新来适应预先训练的模型[61,62,63]. 这些轻量级适应战略还被应用于运动学习、零视合成和轨迹控制的生成,并附带有限的培训数据[64、65、18、45]。 相关研究进一步表明,与运动和相机有关的表达方式集中在特别潜在的渠道或网络层[20,66]. 基于这些发现,WorldForge V2在FLF中使用光学流出提示来将与运动相关的潜在通道定位并减少外观干扰. 我们进一步将这一想法推广到模型化适应中,方法是确定对轨道敏感的区块,并将轻量级LORA仅适用于这些区块,从而能够有效地使轨道与非常有限的培训数据保持一致。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: WorldForge V2 (Fig. 2 ) aims to control camera trajectories while preserving the video priors of pretrained generation models. Given a source image or video and a target camera path, geometric warping first produces a trajectory reference and its visibility mask. WorldForge V2 then uses these signals to guide denoising and generate videos that follow the target path. Sec. III-A introduces the required notation and background. Sec. III-B presents the training-free guidance pipeline: IRR reduces the denoising-state gap through clean-estimate fusion, FLF restricts trajectory injection to motion-related latent channels, and DSG corrects the guided prediction using the model’s original denoising path. Sec. III-C derives a noisy-latent correction that reduces the denoising-state gap with fewer model evaluations. Finally, Sec. III-D identifies trajectory-sensitive network blocks and adapts them with LoRA using limited supervision, enabling data-efficient trajectory control for VDMs.

blocks.en: III-B Inference-Time Trajectory Guidance
blocks.zh: 三-B 推断-时间轨迹指导

blocks.en: Geometric warping explicitly indicates how observed content should move along the target camera path. However, directly inserting the noised reference mixes the externally re-noised visible region with the model-generated region, producing a denoising-state gap that can cause noisy patches and structural errors. We therefore inject the reference through the model-predicted clean estimate and re-noise the fused result with a unified noise sample. We further restrict guidance to motion-related channels and calibrate the guided prediction against the model’s original denoising path. Together, these designs enable training-free trajectory control while preserving visual quality.
blocks.zh: 几何warping明确显示观测到的内容应如何沿着目标相机路径移动. 然而,直接插入被点名的参考物会将外部重新点名的可见区域与模型生成的区域相混合,从而产生去诺克-状态差距,这会造成噪音补丁和结构出错. 因此,我们通过模型预想的清洁估计输入参考,并用统一的噪音样本重新发出引信结果。 我们进一步限制对运动相关通道的指导,并根据模型最初的去名路径校正所引导的预测. 这些设计结合在一起,在保持视觉质量的同时,实现了无训练轨迹控制.

To avoid directly combining these incompatible states, IRR first fuses the warped reference in the model-predicted clean space and then re-noises the fused result with one Gaussian noise sample.

blocks.en: Flow-Gated Latent Fusion (FLF). Camera-trajectory control should separate camera-induced motion from object appearance and intrinsic motion. However, VAE channels encode different types of information, so replacing all channels with the same trajectory signal may also distort appearance. This channel specialization is supported by MOFT, which uses PCA to identify motion-related channels [ 20 ] . Based on this observation, FLF uses optical flow to select channels whose temporal motion agrees with the target trajectory, requiring no gradient-based optimization during inference.

blocks.en: Dual-Path Self-Corrective Guidance (DSG). Warped trajectory references may contain distortions caused by depth errors, occlusions, or misalignment, and these errors can degrade the generated video. Inspired by CFG and AutoGuidance [ 19 , 52 ] , DSG compares a trajectory-guided prediction with the model’s original prediction and uses their difference to refine the guidance, allowing the result to follow the trajectory constraint while improving visual quality.

blocks.en: The fuse-then-renoise process in IRR effectively reduces the denoising-state gap introduced by warped-reference fusion. Building on this, we further improve its sampling efficiency. IRR first evaluates the video model on the original latent to obtain the clean estimate and then evaluates the trajectory-guided latent to continue denoising. Our key observation is that the correction introduced by clean-estimate fusion can be written directly in noisy latent space. We therefore derive this correction and approximate it using the velocity cached from the preceding denoising step. This gives v-cache, a single-forward path for efficient trajectory guidance.

blocks.en: III-D Trajectory-Sensitive LoRA Adaptation
blocks.zh: III-D 轨迹-敏感LORA适应

blocks.en: Optimization-based camera control often relies on full-model fine-tuning or large trainable modules, requiring substantial trajectory–video data and computation. With limited supervision, broad parameter updates may also weaken pretrained visual and spatiotemporal priors, causing degraded geometry or implausible structures. We therefore seek a data-efficient adaptation strategy that strengthens trajectory control with limited supervision while restricting parameter updates to preserve the pretrained priors.
blocks.zh: 基于优化的相机控制往往依赖于全模型的微调或大型可训练模块,需要大量的轨迹-视频数据和计算. 由于监督有限,宽参数更新还可能削弱预受训练的视觉和相片前传,导致几何学退化或结构不合理. 因此,我们寻求一种具有数据效率的适应战略,在有限的监督下加强轨迹控制,同时限制参数更新,以保留事先受过训练的前科。

blocks.en: Our method combines trajectory-sensitive block selection with v-cache-aligned LoRA training. FLF analyzes how motion and appearance features are distributed across latent channels; we extend this localization idea to network blocks and apply LoRA only to blocks that are sensitive to trajectory signals. We then inject trajectories through v-cache and train these adapters on latent states produced by v-cache guidance. This design concentrates limited supervision on trajectory-relevant components and enables data-efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法结合了轨迹敏感区块选择和v-cache-accessed LoRA训练. FLF分析运动和外观特征如何在潜在通道中分布;我们把这个本地化的想法扩展到网络块,并且将LORA仅适用于对轨迹信号敏感的块. 然后我们通过v-cache注入轨迹 并训练这些适配器 在由v-cache引导产生的潜在状态。 这种设计将有限的监督集中在与轨迹有关的组件上,并使得能够进行具有数据效率的适应。

blocks.en: Trajectory-Supervised Data Construction. To construct paired trajectory references and target videos, we use the public DL3DV dataset [ 77 ] , which provides multi-view observations and optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting representations [ 32 ] . For each scene, we select multiple source views and sample several target camera paths for each view. The 3DGS representation provides the source-view depth and renders RGB frames along each target path.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: Our experiments examine how rendered-reference guidance combines camera control with the scene priors of pretrained video models. We first evaluate the training-free framework in static 3D generation and dynamic 4D re-rendering, then study V-Cache correction and data-efficient LoRA adaptation. Transfer experiments examine the reuse of the learned control, and ablations establish the roles of guidance, block selection, and training. We denote the IRR–FLF–DSG framework as Ours (Training-Free) and the adapted models as Ours (LongCat) and Ours (H3) .
blocks.zh: 我们的实验研究了渲染参考指导如何将相机控制与预先训练的视频模型的场景前身相结合. 我们首先在静态3D生成和动态4D重放中评价无训练框架,再研究V-Cache校正和数据高效的LORA适应. 转移实验检查所学控制的再利用情况,而分解则确定了指导、区块选择和培训的作用。 我们将IRR-FLF-DSG框架称为我们的(无训练),将经过改造的模式称为我们的(长猫)和我们的(H3).

blocks.en: IV-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 实验设置

blocks.en: For training-free camera control, we use Wan2.1 I2V-14B [ 2 ] , with IRR applied during early denoising. We implement Trajectory LoRA on LongCat-Video [ 71 ] and MiniMax-H3 by adapting selected self-attention projections while keeping the pretrained weights fixed. Both models use anchor warm-up followed by training on guided latent states. Detailed training and inference settings are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 对于无训练相机控制,我们使用Wan2.1 I2V-14B[2],早期去诺时应用IRR. 我们通过调整选定的自我观察预测,同时固定预先训练的重量,在LongCat-Video[71]和MiniMax-H3上执行Trajectory LoRA。 这两种模式都采用锚地热疗,然后进行关于有指导的潜在状态的培训。 补充材料提供了详细的培训和推断环境。

blocks.en: The training-free evaluation covers static scenes and dynamic videos from diverse sources. The static 3D setting contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF [ 79 ] , Tanks and Temples [ 80 ] , Mip-NeRF 360 [ 81 ] , and real or generated images. The dynamic 4D setting contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS [ 82 ] , movie clips, and videos generated by video diffusion models.
blocks.zh: 无培训评价涵盖来自不同来源的静态场景和动态视频. 静态3D设置包含来自超过40个场景的超过70个来源视图,包括LLFF [79],坦克和圣殿 [80],Mip-NERF 360 [81],以及真实或生成的图像. 动态4D设置包含超过30个源视频的50多个由轨迹控制的输出,包括DAVIS [82],电影剪辑,以及由视频传播模型所生成的视频.

blocks.en: For LoRA adaptation, we construct trajectory–video pairs from optimized 3D Gaussian Splatting representations [ 32 ] of DL3DV scenes [ 77 ] . Warping a source view along a target camera path provides the partial reference and its visibility mask; rendering the scene along the same path supplies the target video. The main comparison uses 200 test cases, with five random camera trajectories per scene across 40 scenes. Sequences contain 25–93 frames, with the length adapted to each method’s supported input format. Training and test scenes are disjoint.
blocks.zh: 对于LORA的适应,我们构建出轨迹 - 视频对对 从优化的 3D 高斯平板显示 [32] DL3DV场景 [77]. 沿目标相机路径向源视图显示会提供部分参考及其能见度口罩;使场景沿着同一条路径提供目标视频. 主比较采用200个测试案例,每个场景有5个随机相机轨迹,跨越了40个场景. 序列包含25–93帧,长度可适应每种方法所支持的输入格式. 训练和测试场景是脱节的。

blocks.en: We evaluate visual quality and camera accuracy together. The training-free experiments use FID and CLIP similarity for static scenes, and FVD and CLIP-V similarity for dynamic videos. For Trajectory LoRA, we additionally evaluate target-view reconstruction with pixel-level metrics, PSNR and SSIM, and the perceptual metric LPIPS. Vis-LPIPS and Disocc-LPIPS assess preservation of visible content and completion of newly exposed regions, respectively. ATE measures overall trajectory agreement, while RPE-T and RPE-R measure local translation and rotation errors. Metric implementations are specified in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们一起评估视觉质量和相机准确性。 无训练实验采用FID和CLIP相似来进行静态场景,而FVD和CLIP-V相似来进行动态视频. 对于 Tropjectory LORA,我们用像素级的度量衡,PSNR和SSIM,以及感知度量的LPIPS来额外评价目标-视图重建. Vis-LPIPS和Diocc-LPIPS分别评估了新曝光区域的可见内容的保存和完成情况. ATE测量总体轨迹协议,而RTE-T和RTE-R测量本地翻译和旋转错误. 补充材料中具体规定了计量标准的执行情况。

blocks.en: IV-B Inference-Time Camera-Trajectory Control
blocks.zh: IV-B 推断时间相机相机相机相机控制

blocks.en: We evaluate whether warped-reference guidance can follow a prescribed camera path while retaining the scene priors of a frozen video backbone. For static 3D generation, we compare with See3D [ 49 ] , ViewCrafter [ 4 ] , ViewExtrapolator [ 17 ] , TrajectoryAttention [ 15 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , and NVS-Solver [ 6 ] . For dynamic 4D re-rendering, we compare with ViewExtrapolator, TrajectoryAttention, and TrajectoryCrafter using matched source videos and target trajectories. blocks.en: Tables I and II show that Ours (Training-Free) combines accurate camera motion with strong generation quality. It achieves the best results on all static metrics and leads in FVD, CLIP-V similarity, RPE-T, and RPE-R on dynamic videos. Under large viewpoint changes, our method preserves human identity, object motion, and scene structure (Fig. 3 ). Competing methods more often produce flattened geometry, floating structures, or implausible content in newly revealed regions. The warped references provide explicit camera constraints, while the video model supplies the scene content needed for realistic 3D and 4D generation.
blocks.zh: 表一和表二显示,Ours(Training-Free)结合了准确相机运动和强生成质量. 它在所有静态度量衡上都取得了最佳结果,并在动态视频上以FVD,CLIP-V相似性,RTE-T和RTE-R等领先. 在大视角变化下,我们的方法保留了人类的身份,物体运动,以及场景结构(图3). 相竞方法更常产生平分几何,浮动结构,或者在被新揭示的区域产生不可信的内容. 被扭曲的引用提供了明显的相机限制,而视频模型则提供了现实3D和4D生成所需的场景内容.

blocks.en: IV-C V-Cache Correction and Data-Efficient LoRA
blocks.zh: IV-C V 缓存校正和数据有效LORA

blocks.en: The training-free results establish rendered references as an effective source of camera guidance. We next examine two questions: can the clean-estimate correction be approximated directly in noisy latent space to reduce sampling cost, and can limited trajectory supervision be concentrated in the network components most useful for camera control? V-Cache addresses the first question, while Trajectory LoRA uses this selective adaptation to learn control from very little data.
blocks.zh: 无培训成果将参考文献确定为摄影指导的有效来源。 我们接下来要研究两个问题:能否直接在噪音低的潜在空间中对清洁估计的校正进行近似,以减少采样成本;有限的轨迹监督能否集中在对相机控制最有用的网络组件上? V-Cache处理第一个问题,而Trajectory LoRA则使用这种选择性的适应来从极少的数据中学习控制.

blocks.en: Direct reference insertion combines an externally noised observation with a latent following the model’s denoising path. To test their noise-state compatibility, we compare Direct Insertion, Only IRR, and V-Cache across denoising steps with the same inputs, target trajectories, and sampling settings (Fig. 4 ). For a latent x i x_{i} at noise level σ i \sigma_{i} , the model velocity v i v_{i} gives the inferred noise endpoint ϵ ^ i = x i + ( 1 − σ i ) ​ v i \hat{\epsilon}_{i}=x_{i}+(1-\sigma_{i})v_{i} . We compute its mean and variance in the warped-visible and model-generated regions and plot the mean and log-variance gaps. Direct Insertion leaves persistent gaps, accompanied by noisy patches, discontinuous boundaries, and local structural errors. IRR reduces these gaps by fusing the reference in clean-estimate space and re-noising the result with one noise sample. V-Cache achieves a similar reduction without additional model evaluations (NFE), making correction more efficient.

IRR通过将参考物放入干净的估计空间并用一个噪音样本重新点出结果来缩小这些差距. V-Cache在不追加模型评价(NFE)的情况下实现类似的削减,使校正更有效率.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: Noise-state consistency under different reference-insertion strategies. Direct Insertion leaves gaps in the inferred-noise mean and log-variance between visible and model-generated regions, accompanied by noisy patches and broken structure. IRR reduces these gaps, and V-Cache approximates its correction while retaining continuous surfaces and clear geometric detail.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4: 不同参考插入战略下的噪声状态一致性。 直接插入在可见和模型生成区域之间的推断-噪声平均值和日志变量中留下了空白,伴有噪音补丁和断裂的结构. IRR缩小了这些缺口,而V-Cache在保持连续地表和清晰的几何细节的同时,大致修正了.

blocks.en: Trajectory LoRA adapts only selected trajectory-sensitive blocks to strengthen the model’s response to camera guidance. We use V-Cache to inject the target trajectory and compare the adapted models with UniWorld-View [ 83 ] , TrajectoryCrafter [ 5 ] , SymphoMotion [ 84 ] , and Warp-as-History [ 18 ] on trajectory accuracy, preservation of observed content, and completion of newly revealed regions. Both models use rank-128 LoRA and 50 trajectory–video training pairs. LongCat adapts its 36 most trajectory-sensitive blocks (75%) for 1,200 updates using eight scenes; H3 adapts its 38 most sensitive blocks (approximately 75%) for 1,500 updates using one scene. These main-comparison settings are the defaults for ablations, which vary the factor under study.
blocks.zh: 轨迹LORA只适应一些对轨迹敏感的块来强化模型对相机向导的反应. 我们使用V-Cache来注入目标轨迹,并将所改造的模型与UniWorld-View [83],TraphioryCrafter [5], SymphoMotion [84],和Warp-as-History [18] 比较,关于轨迹准确性,所观测内容的保存,以及新披露区域的完成. 两个型号都使用一级-128 LoRA和50个轨迹-视频训练对. LongCat利用8个场景调整了它的36个最有轨迹敏感性的区块(75%),用于1200个更新;H3利用一个场景调整了它的38个最敏感区块(约75%),用于1500个更新. 这些主比较设置是活化的默认值,它改变了所研究的因素.

blocks.en: Both adapted models outperform the baselines on all five reconstruction metrics (Table III ). The gains in Vis-LPIPS and Disocc-LPIPS show improved preservation of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions. H3 also achieves the lowest local camera errors, combining faithful scene reconstruction with accurate camera motion. Figure 5 illustrates these improvements in thin structures and partially revealed objects: our models retain material detail and coherent shapes where the warped reference is incomplete, producing fewer rendering artifacts and more continuous geometry along the requested path.
blocks.zh: 两个经调整的模型都超过了所有五个重建指标的基线(表三)。 Vis-LPIPS和Disoc-LPIPS的成绩表明,已观测到的内容得到更好的保存并完成了新暴露区域的工作。 H3还实现了最低的局部相机出错,将忠实的场景重建与准确相机运动相结合. 图5说明了薄结构和部分被披露物体的这些改进:我们的模型在被扭曲的参考材料不完整的地方保留了物质细节和连贯的形状,产生的渲染文物较少,沿所请求的路径更连续地几何.

blocks.en: Fig. 5: Qualitative comparison of camera-controlled scene generation. Our LongCat and H3 models recover coherent object shapes and material detail from incomplete warped references, including thin structures and partially revealed objects. Compared with the baselines, they produce fewer rendering remnants and more continuous geometry, preserving scene appearance as the camera reveals new content.
blocks.zh: 发相. 5:相机控制场景生成定性比较. 我们的LongCat和H3模型从不完整的被扭曲的参考物中恢复了连贯的物体形状和材料细节,包括薄结构和部分被揭示的物体. 与基线相比,它们产生较少的渲染后遗迹和更连续的几何,随着相机揭示出新的内容而保持了场景外观.

blocks.en: IV-D Additional Results
blocks.zh: 四-D 其他结果

blocks.en: The inference-time guidance transfers directly to the U-Net-based SVD [ 1 ] and the Transformer-based LongCat-Video, and remains effective with different depth and optical-flow estimators (see the supplementary material). Trajectory LoRA offers a complementary form of transfer. The same LongCat adapter can be attached to Warp-as-History [ 18 ] and Go-with-the-Flow [ 16 ] without further fine-tuning. It improves the model’s response to the injected trajectory under both methods, reducing structural degradation and preserving more surface and object detail (Fig. 6 ). These results show that the selected blocks learn broader trajectory-control capabilities that transfer across injection interfaces.
blocks.zh: 推论时间制导直接传输到以U-Net为基础的SVD [1]和以变形器为基础的LongCat-Video,并以不同的深度和光学流量估计器(见补充材料)仍然有效. 轨迹LORA提供了一种补充形式的转让。 同样的"长卡特"适配器可以被接入"Warp-as-History"[18]和"Go-with-the-Flow"[16]而无需再作进一步的微调. 它改进了模型在两种方法下对被注入道的反应,减少了结构退化并保存了更多的地表和物体细节(图6)。 这些结果显示,所选区块学习了更广泛的轨迹控制能力,可以跨注入界面进行传输.

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Qualitative transfer of Trajectory LoRA across camera-control methods. Without additional fine-tuning, the same trained LongCat adapter improves surface continuity and object detail in WAH [ 18 ] and GWF [ 16 ] , demonstrating transferable trajectory control.
blocks.zh: 发相. 6:通过相机控制方法对轨迹LORA进行定性转移. 同样的训练有素的LongCat适配器在WAH [18]和GWF [16]中改进了表面连续性和物体细节,显示了可转移的轨道控制.

blocks.en: Training resources and inference efficiency, including accelerated generation with Trajectory LoRA, are reported in Sec. 4.4 of the supplementary material (Table S4 ).
blocks.zh: 补充材料第4.4节(表S4)报告了培训资源和推论效率,包括利用Trapriory LoRA加速生成。

blocks.en: IV-E Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: IV-E 读取研究

blocks.en: Our ablations test how each design contributes to camera control. Following the noise-state analysis of IRR and V-Cache, we examine how FLF and DSG preserve generation quality during trajectory guidance. We then assess the effectiveness of the selected trajectory-sensitive blocks, how efficiently these blocks learn from limited scenes, and how the two training stages prepare the adapter for V-Cache-guided denoising.
blocks.zh: 我们测试每个设计如何促进相机控制 在对IRR和V-Cache进行噪音状态分析后,我们研究了FLF和DSG如何在轨迹引导中保持生成质量. 然后,我们评估选定轨道敏感区块的有效性,这些区块如何有效地从有限的场景中学习,以及两个培训阶段如何使适配器为V-Cache制导的去Noing做好准备.

blocks.en: IRR injects the target trajectory through the warped reference; removing this injection leaves the model without camera guidance. FLF confines reference fusion to channels aligned with the target motion, allowing the others to retain the model’s appearance prediction. Removing this selection applies fusion to all channels and disrupts appearance. DSG corrects warped-reference distortions using the model’s original prediction. The guided and unguided velocities differ substantially in direction, making standard CFG unstable. Table IV shows that removing FLF or DSG reduces static and dynamic generation quality, while replacing DSG with its CFG form causes further degradation. The complete framework performs best on all four quality metrics, combining appearance-preserving fusion with correction of guidance artifacts. Qualitative component comparisons are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: IRR通过被扭曲的引用来给目标轨迹注入;去除这种注入使得模型没有相机指向. FLF将参考聚变限制在与目标运动相配合的通道上,允许其他机型保留外观预测. 删除此选择会对所有频道应用聚变并打乱外观 。 DSG 使用模型的原始预测来校正误差引用扭曲. 制导和非制导速度在方向上差别很大,使标准CFG不稳定. 表四显示去除FLF或DSG会降低静态和动态生成质量,而用其CFG形式来取而代之DSG则会导致进一步的降解. 完整的框架在所有四个质量度量标准上表现最好,将外观保护聚变与校正指导文物相结合. 补充材料中提供了定性成分比较。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Quantitative ablation of inference-time guidance. IRR supplies the trajectory signal; removing its reference injection leaves the model without camera guidance. With IRR fixed, we remove FLF, DSG, or both, or replace DSG with its CFG form. Both components improve generation quality, and their combination performs best on static and dynamic scenes. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best results.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:量化推断时间指导. IRR提供轨迹信号;去掉其参考注射使模型没有相机指向. 随着IRR的固定,我们删除了FLF,DSG,或者两者兼而有之,或者用其CFG形式来取代DSG. 两个组件都提高了生成质量,它们的组合在静态和动态场景上表现最好. 大胆和强调地标出最佳和次好的结果。

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Shapley analysis of block sensitivity to trajectory supervision. After approximately 400 steps of probe LoRA training, contributions are estimated from 25 trajectory pairs per backbone. Sensitive blocks are dispersed through the middle and later layers of LongCat and show a more regular concentration in the later layers of H3. This variation identifies the blocks to prioritize for adaptation.
blocks.zh: 发相. 7:对弹道监督的区块敏感度进行精细分析. 经过大约400个步骤的探测LORA培训后,估计每个主干线有25个轨迹对。 敏感区块被分散于长卡特的中层和后层,并显示出后层H3的更常态浓度. 这一变化确定了需要优先适应的区块。

blocks.en: TABLE V: Quantitative comparison of LoRA adaptation with different block selections. Blocks are ranked by Shapley sensitivity; parentheses give the number adapted. Random uses half of the blocks, with metrics averaged over five training runs; Low response uses the least sensitive half. Other training settings follow the default configuration. Selecting roughly the most sensitive three quarters matches full-block performance and improves several reconstruction and camera metrics. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best results within each backbone.
blocks.zh: 表五:洛拉适应与不同区块选择的定量比较。 块按Shapley敏感度排列;括号给出了被修改的数字. 随机使用半个区块,平均分量在5个以上的训练运行;低响应使用最不敏感的半个. 其他训练设置遵循了默认配置. 选择大约最敏感的四分之三与全块的性能相匹配,并改进若干重建和相机的衡量标准。 大胆地强调每个骨干部门的最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en: Fig. 8: Effect of training updates on generation quality and camera control. LongCat trains more stably with eight scenes and reaches its best perceptual quality near 1,200 updates; longer training shows signs of overfitting. H3 learns reliably from one scene. Removing LoRA from its less sensitive blocks accelerates convergence and improves perceptual quality compared with full-block adaptation. Additional updates yield diminishing gains.
blocks.zh: 发相. 8:培训更新对生成质量和相机控制的影响。 LongCat列车有8个场景,在接近1200个更新时达到其最佳的感知质量;更长时间的训练显示出过于适应的迹象. H3从一个场景中可靠地学习. 与整块改造相比,将LORA从其不太敏感的区块中去除加快了趋同,提高了知觉质量. 额外更新收益减少。

blocks.en: TABLE VI: Effect of training-scene diversity on camera-controlled generation. The total number of training pairs is fixed. Both backbones already produce good results after single-scene training; covering two to four scenes captures most gains from added diversity. Further expansion brings limited benefit, showing that the adapter can learn reliable camera control from few training scenes. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best results within each backbone.
blocks.zh: 表格 六:培训场景多样性对相机控制生成的影响。 培训对口总数固定. 两个骨干在单场训练后已经产生好结果;覆盖了两到四个场景,捕捉了从增加的多样性中获得的大部分收益. 进一步的扩展带来了有限的收益,表明适配器可以从很少的训练场景中学习可靠的相机控制. 大胆地强调每个骨干部门的最佳和次佳成果。

blocks.en: TABLE VII: Quantitative ablation of the two-stage training strategy and Trajectory LoRA. Standard FM trains on independently noised targets; Only warm-up and w/o warm-up isolate adaptation to recorded states and training across additional noise levels. Full combines both stages and improves reconstruction over Standard FM on both backbones, with the best camera accuracy on H3. Removing LoRA gives the poorest reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表七:两阶段培训战略和轨迹LORA的数量变化。 标准调频列车在独立点名的目标上; 只有取暖和/o取暖才能隔离对有记录的状态的适应和跨额外噪音水平的训练. 完全结合了两个阶段,并改进了两个骨干上通过标准调频的重建,H3上最精准相机. 清除LORA可以帮助最贫困的重建。

blocks.en: Fig. 9: Qualitative comparison of Trajectory LoRA training strategies. For LongCat (a) and H3 (b), two examples per backbone place the input and warped reference beside No LoRA, Standard FM, and the full method. The full strategy reduces fragmented geometry and residual rendering artifacts, producing more continuous surfaces and finer scene detail than No LoRA and Standard FM. Red boxes and enlarged crops compare corresponding regions.
blocks.zh: 发相. 9:轨迹LORA训练策略定性比较. 对于LongCat(a)和H3(b),每个主干线有两个例子将输入和被扭曲的参考置于无LORA、标准调频和全方法之外。 完整的策略会减少零碎的几何和残余渲染文物,产生比"No LoRA"和"标准调频"更连续的地表和更细细的场景细节. 红盒子和扩大的作物比较相应的区域.

blocks.en: We use Shapley analysis [ 78 ] to measure how strongly each self-attention block responds to trajectory supervision. A block’s score averages its marginal contribution to the full probe LoRA’s velocity response across different combinations of active adapters. After brief probe LoRA training on each backbone, Fig. 7 reveals clear differences in sensitivity. LongCat’s responsive blocks are dispersed through the middle and later layers, while H3 shows a more regular concentration in later layers.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Shapley分析[78] 来衡量每个自觉障碍对轨迹监督的强烈反应. 一个区块的分数平均能对全探测器LORA的速度反应做出微小的贡献,跨越不同组合的活性适配器. 在对每个骨干进行短暂的LORA训练后,图7揭示出明显的灵敏度差异. 长 猫的应答区块被分散在中层和后层,而H3则在后层显示出更常的浓度.

blocks.en: To test whether this sensitivity guides effective adaptation, we train different proportions of the highest-scoring blocks and compare them with full-block adaptation. Controls use the least responsive half or a random half, with random-selection results averaged over five independent training runs. All LoRA ablations use the same 100 test cases: five random camera trajectories from each of 20 randomly selected DL3DV scenes, disjoint from all training scenes. Other training settings follow the default configuration.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这种敏感性是否指导有效的适应,我们训练出不同比例的得分最高的区块,并将其与全区块的适应进行比较. 控制使用反应最差的一半或随机的一半,随机选取的结果平均超过5个独立训练跑. 所有LORA活化都使用相同的100个测试案例:从20个随机选取的DL3DV场景中各有5个随机相机轨迹,与所有训练场景脱节. 其他训练设置遵循了默认配置.

blocks.en: Adapting roughly the most sensitive three quarters of the blocks matches or improves full-block performance (Table V ). LongCat’s 36 selected blocks improve reconstruction and local camera accuracy, while H3’s 38 selected blocks retain comparable reconstruction and reduce camera errors. These gains support leaving low-sensitivity blocks unadapted to preserve pretrained texture and appearance priors. The selected H3 blocks also reach good performance sooner than full-block adaptation (Fig. 8 ). At the same block count, selecting the sensitive half improves reconstruction over random selection on both backbones, while low-response selection performs worst. These comparisons validate our block-selection strategy.
blocks.zh: 大约调整最敏感的四分之三区块匹配或改进了整块区块的性能(表五)。 长 Cat的36个选定区块提高了重建与局部相机的准确性,而H3的38个选定区块保留了可比较的重建并减少了相机出错. 这些收益支持使低灵敏度区块无法适应,以保留被事先训练的纹理和外观前缀. 所选的H3区块也比整区块的改造更快地达到良好的性能(图8. 在同一块计数中,选择敏感的一半会比两个主干线上的随机选择改善重建,而低响应选择表现最差. 这些比较验证了我们的区块选择策略.

blocks.en: With adaptation focused on trajectory-sensitive blocks, we examine how much scene diversity is needed for reliable camera control. We draw a fixed total of 50 trajectory–video pairs from one, two, four, or eight DL3DV scenes, keeping other training settings unchanged. Both backbones already achieve good reconstruction and control with one scene (Table VI ). Added diversity improves LongCat’s reconstruction and rotation accuracy, while H3 gains mainly in translation accuracy. Most gains are reached with two to four scenes; extending coverage to eight brings limited further benefit. These results show that the training strategy uses scene supervision efficiently, enabling reliable trajectory control and high-quality generation on unseen scenes from few examples.
blocks.zh: 由于适应的重点是对轨迹敏感的块,我们审查了可靠的相机控制需要多少场景多样性。 我们从1、2、4或8个DL3DV场景中绘制了50个固定的轨迹-视频对,保持其他训练设置不变。 两个骨干已经用一个场景实现了良好的重建和控制(表六)。 添加了多样性,提高了LongCat的重建和旋转精度,而H3主要在翻译精度上有所提升. 大部分成果是通过两到四个场景实现的;将覆盖面扩大到八个场景带来的进一步惠益有限。 这些结果表明,培训战略有效地利用现场监督,使得能够进行可靠的轨迹控制和从少数例子看在看不见的场景上产生高质量的成果。

blocks.en: We next vary training updates while fixing each backbone’s training data and other settings. Figure 8 tracks the eight-scene LongCat and single-scene H3 configurations, with additional scene-count comparisons and full-block adaptation on H3. LongCat trains more stably with eight scenes and reaches its best perceptual quality near 1,200 updates; longer training brings little benefit and eventually shows signs of overfitting. H3 learns reliably from one scene. Removing LoRA from its less sensitive blocks accelerates convergence and improves perceptual quality over full-block adaptation. Later updates refine camera accuracy as perceptual quality stabilizes, with diminishing gains. Thus, the sensitive blocks learn to use trajectory guidance within relatively few updates.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们将在修改每个主干单位的培训数据和其他设置时,对培训更新进行修改。 图8追踪了八景长卡和单景H3的配置,在H3上增加了场景计数比较和全块适应. LongCat列车有8个场景,在接近1200个更新时达到其最佳的感知质量;更长时间的训练没有带来什么好处,并最终显示出超合的迹象. H3从一个场景中可靠地学习. 将LORA从其较不敏感的区块中去除,加速了趋同,并在整块区块的适应上提高了知觉质量. 后作更新后,随着感知质量稳定,镜头精度得到完善,收益逐渐减少. 因此,敏感区块学会在相对较少的更新中使用轨迹引导.

blocks.en: We compare Standard FM, Only warm-up, and w/o warm-up to isolate the effects of the training strategies, using 1,200 updates for LongCat and 1,500 for H3. The adapter must learn to denoise states modified by reference insertion and cached correction. Anchor warm-up first adapts it to intermediate states recorded during guided sampling; the second stage uses the warmed-up model and these states to construct guided inputs at additional noise levels. Table VII and Fig. 9 compare these variants with Full and w/o LoRA under fixed inference settings for each backbone. Standard FM uses independently noised targets. Only warm-up trains on recorded states without extending the noise range, while w/o warm-up skips initial adaptation but still constructs guided inputs from intermediate states at additional noise levels. The full strategy gives the best overall results across quantitative and qualitative comparisons, improving reconstruction over Standard FM on both backbones and achieving the best camera accuracy on H3. Removing LoRA gives the poorest reconstruction. Although Standard FM has low errors on some camera metrics, its training inputs differ substantially from inference-time guided states. This gap prevents reliable use of trajectory guidance, leaving holes, cracks, and rendering artifacts. Training on states that reproduce guided denoising restores continuous surfaces and finer detail.
blocks.zh: 我们比较标准调频,只有取暖,和w/o取暖,以隔离训练策略的效果,使用1200个更新为长卡特,1500个更新为H3. 适配器必须学会通过引用插入和缓存校正修改的denoise状态. Anchor warm-up首先使其适应被制导取样时所记录的中间状态;第二阶段使用取暖模型和这些状态来构造被制导到的额外噪音水平的投入. 表七和图9将这些变体与Full和w/o LoRA在每个主干线的固定推论设置下进行比较。 标准调频使用独立点名的目标. 只有热能列车在有记录的状态上没有延长噪音范围,而W/o热能列车跳过初始适应,但仍以额外的噪音水平构建来自中间状态的导引输入. 全面战略在定量和定性比较方面提供了最佳的总体成果,改进了主干线上与标准调频上的重建,并实现了H3上的最佳相机精度. 清除LORA可以帮助最贫困的重建。 虽然标准调频在一些相机测量标准上存在低误差,但其培训投入与推断时间制导状态差别很大. 这种差距妨碍了可靠地使用轨迹向导,留下了洞口,裂缝和渲染文物. 关于复制有指导作用的去诺能恢复连续表面和更细细细节的状态的培训。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented WorldForge V2 for accurate camera control while preserving the generative capabilities of pretrained video models. Our training-free guidance uses warped references to iteratively refine generation along the requested camera path, with motion-aware channel selection and self-correction preserving scene appearance and object motion. Building on this guidance, v-cache reuses denoising predictions to approximate the refinement correction, reducing sampling cost. Trajectory LoRA extends motion localization from latent channels to network blocks and combines selective adaptation with two-stage training, enabling pretrained video models to learn reliable trajectory control from very few trajectory–video pairs. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art generation quality and trajectory accuracy in camera-controlled video generation. Future work will explore long-horizon, real-time streaming generation with camera control to support the development of interactive world models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了WorldForge V2,用于精确的相机控制,同时保留了预先训练的视频模型的基因能力. 我们的无训练指导使用被扭曲的引用,沿所请求的相机路径反复地精炼出生成,有运动-意识通道选择和自我修正,保存场景外观和物体运动. 在这个指导的基础上,V-cache再利用去诺预测,以接近精度校正,降低采样成本. 轨迹LORA将运动局部化从潜入通道延伸至网络块,并将选择性的适应与两级训练相结合,使预先训练的视频模型能够从极少的轨迹-视频对等学习可靠的轨迹控制. 多个数据集的定量和定性评价显示相机控制的视频生成中最先进的生成质量和轨迹准确性。 未来工作将探索长相相机,有相机控制的实时流线生成,以支持互动世界模型的发展.

2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 2. 评价议定书

blocks.en: Camera control requires the generated video to follow the target path while preserving the scene. We evaluate these two aspects through visual quality and trajectory accuracy on the training-free benchmarks, and use the rendered DL3DV targets to further examine reconstruction of observed content and completion of newly exposed regions.
blocks.zh: 相机控制需要生成的视频在保存场景的同时遵循目标路径. 我们通过在无培训基准上的视觉质量和轨迹精确度来评价这两个方面,并利用提供的DL3DV目标,进一步审查所观察到内容的重建和新曝光区域的完成情况。

blocks.en: 2.1 Data and Comparison Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据和比较协议

blocks.en: The training-free static benchmark contains more than 70 source views from over 40 scenes, including LLFF, Tanks and Temples, Mip-NeRF 360, and real or generated images. The dynamic benchmark contains more than 50 trajectory-controlled outputs from over 30 source videos, including DAVIS, cinematic sequences, and videos generated by video diffusion models.
blocks.zh: 无培训静态基准包含来自40多场景的70多处原始视图,包括LLFF,Tanks and Temples,Mip-NERF 360等,以及真实或生成的图像. 动态基准包含超过30个源视频的50多个由轨迹控制的输出,包括DAVIS,电影序列,以及由视频传播模型所生成的视频.

blocks.en: The learned-control experiments use DL3DV [ 77 ] , with disjoint training and test scenes. The main comparison contains 200 cases, with five random camera paths for each of 40 scenes. All LoRA ablations use the same 100 cases, comprising five random paths from each of 20 randomly selected scenes. blocks.en: For training-free control with Wan2.1 I2V-14B, we use a 50-step UniPC sampler and apply Intra-Step Recursive Refinement (IRR) during the first 20 steps by default. blocks.en: Early latent states are too noisy for reliable flow estimation, so we disable channel filtering and inject the reference into all channels during steps 0–5. As the motion estimates become more reliable, we allow at most two of Wan2.1’s 16 channels to retain the original prediction during steps 6–10; at least 14 channels therefore continue to receive the reference. During steps 11–19, we relax this limit to six channels, giving the model more freedom to recover texture while maintaining trajectory guidance in the remaining channels. These indices are zero-based and cover the first 20 guided steps.
blocks.zh: 早期潜伏状态对于可靠的流量估计来说太吵了,因此我们在0–5步骤中禁用通道过滤并注入所有通道的引用. 随着运动估计的更可靠,我们最多允许Wan2.1的16个频道中有两个在6-10步骤中保留原先的预测;因此,至少14个频道继续得到参考。 在11–19步骤中,我们把这一限制放宽到6道,使模型在保持其余道道轨迹向导的同时有更多的恢复纹理的自由. 这些指标基于零,涵盖前20个指导步骤。

blocks.en: V-Cache approximates IRR’s clean-state correction in noisy latent space using the velocity cached from the preceding denoising step. The first guided step uses direct reference insertion; subsequent steps within the correction interval use the cached velocity to correct the latent before model evaluation. The new prediction advances the sampler and updates the cache, avoiding the extra model evaluation used by IRR for correction.

blocks.en: Trajectory LoRA adapts selected blocks to follow rendered camera guidance while preserving scene content. We construct training pairs from optimized 3D Gaussian representations [ 32 ] of DL3DV scenes [ 77 ] . For a source view and target camera path, depth-based warping provides a partial reference and its visibility mask, while rendering the scene along the same path provides the target video. Video-VAE encoding gives the trajectory latent x traj x_{\mathrm{traj}} and clean target latent x 0 gt x_{0}^{\mathrm{gt}} . The target video supervises both preservation of visible content and completion of newly exposed regions.

On each backbone, the trained trajectory LoRA can be combined with the released acceleration LoRA without retraining. Generation times and visual comparisons are provided in Sec. 4.4 .

blocks.en: To examine transfer across camera-guidance methods, we reuse the trained LongCat LoRA with Warp-as-History [ 18 ] and Go-with-the-Flow [ 16 ] on the LongCat backbone. Each method provides its own trajectory condition, and the LoRA is applied without further fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了检查跨相机指导方法的转移,我们重新使用训练有素的"长凯特·洛拉"(LongCat LoRA)与"Warp-as-History [18]"和"去花"在"长凯特"骨干上. 每一种方法都提供了自己的轨迹条件,而LORA的应用没有作进一步的微调.

blocks.en: 4 Additional Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个额外实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Component Behavior and Motion Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1 行为和运动选择

blocks.en: In training-free WorldForge, introducing a rendered reference gives IRR direct control over camera motion, while FLF and DSG help preserve the scene during this change. In Fig. S1 , FLF reduces appearance distortions from reference fusion, and DSG further corrects the guided prediction using the original prediction. Their combination produces coherent scene content along the requested camera path.
blocks.zh: 在无训练的"WorldForge"中,引入了被渲染的参考文献,使得IRR直接控制了相机的运动,而FLF和DSG在此变化中帮助保存了场景. 入法义. S1,FLF会从参考聚变中减少外观扭曲,而DSG会用原来的预测进一步校正被引导的预测. 它们的组合沿所请求的相机路径产生连贯的场景内容.

blocks.en: Figure S1: Contribution of IRR, FLF, and DSG to training-free camera control. IRR introduces the target camera motion; adding FLF reduces appearance distortions during reference fusion, and DSG further corrects the guided prediction. The complete method preserves coherent scene content along the requested camera path.
blocks.zh: 图S1:IRR、FLF和DSG对无培训相机控制的贡献。 IRR引入了目标相机运动;添加了FLF会减少参考聚变过程中的外观扭曲,而DSG进一步纠正了被引导的预测. 完整的方法沿所请求的相机路径保存了连贯的场景内容.

blocks.en: For training-free control, FLF selects channels by comparing their motion with the rendered reference. Figure S2 records how often each channel retains its original prediction across more than 40 static and 30 dynamic scenes. The stable differences in filtering frequency reflect differences in motion relevance: selected channels receive camera guidance, while the remaining channels preserve information from the model’s prediction.
blocks.zh: 对于无训练控制,FLF通过将其运动与给出的参考物进行比较来选择频道. 图S2记录了每个频道在超过40个静态和30个动态场景中保留其原始预测的频率. 滤波频率的稳定差异反映了运动相关性的差异:所选通道接收相机指向,而其余通道则保存模型预测中的信息.

blocks.en: Figure S2: Channel filtering frequencies for training-free control over more than 40 static and 30 dynamic scenes. A higher frequency means that a channel more often retains its original prediction. Stable differences across channels support selecting where to inject the camera guidance according to motion relevance.
blocks.zh: 图S2:用于对超过40个静态和30个动态场景进行无培训控制的通道过滤频率. 更高的频率意味着一个信道更经常地保留了原来的预测. 不同频道间的稳定差异支持根据运动关联性选择插入相机向导的位置.

blocks.en: 4.2 Self-Corrective Guidance
blocks.zh: 4.2 自更正指导

blocks.en: The original and trajectory-guided predictions can point in substantially different directions, making their combination sensitive to the guidance rule. In Fig. S3 , directly applying standard CFG introduces structural artifacts, and removing DSG’s adaptive angular weight weakens consistency. The complete DSG uses cosine-based projection and adaptive weighting to combine the predictions, preserving scene structure and fine detail as it follows the rendered guidance.
blocks.zh: 最初的和由轨迹制导的预测可以指向大相径庭的方向,使其组合对制导规则敏感. 入法义. S3,直接应用标准的CFG引入了结构文物,去除DSG的适应角重会削弱一致性. 完整的DSG采用以余弦为主的投影和适应性分量来结合预测,保留场景结构,并遵循所制导的精细细节.

blocks.en: Figure S3: Combining the original and trajectory-guided predictions for training-free camera control. Standard CFG introduces structural artifacts, and removing DSG’s adaptive angular weight weakens consistency. Cosine-based projection with adaptive weighting preserves scene structure and fine detail in the guided result.
blocks.zh: 图S3:结合原生和轨迹导引的预测,用于无训练相机控制. 标准CFG引入了结构文物,去除DSG的适应角重会削弱一致性. 具有适应性分量的以余弦为主的投影能保持场景结构并保持被引导结果的细微细节.

blocks.en: 4.3 Backbone and Geometry Compatibility
blocks.zh: 4.3 后骨和几何相容性

blocks.en: We apply the same training-free guidance to the U-Net-based SVD [ 1 ] and the transformer-based LongCat-Video [ 71 ] . Table S3 compares them with Wan2.1 on more than 40 static scenes. Wan2.1 and LongCat-Video improve both CLIP similarity and camera accuracy over SVD, showing that the shared control mechanism can benefit from stronger video backbones. Figure S4 compares guidance methods under a shared SVD backbone and shows the richer scene detail obtained with LongCat-Video.
blocks.zh: 我们对以U-Net为基础的SVD[1]和以变压器为基础的LongCat-Video[71]适用同样的无培训指导. 表S3在超过40个静态场景中将其与Wan2.1作比较. Wan2.1和LongCat-Video都比SVD提高了CLIP的相似性和相机精度,表明共享控制机制可以从更强大的视频主干线中获益. 图S4比较了共享SVD主干下的指导方法,并显示了与LongCat-Video公司获得的更丰富的场景细节.

blocks.en: Table S3: Training-free camera control across three video backbones on the static benchmark of more than 40 scenes. All backbones use the same rendered-reference guidance. LongCat-Video leads on CLIP and RPE-T, while Wan2.1 leads on ATE and RPE-R; both improve all reported metrics over SVD. Bold and underlining mark the best and second-best results.
blocks.zh: 表S3:40多场景的静态基准上跨出3个视频主干线的无培训相机控制. 所有骨干都使用相同的渲染参考指导. 长 Cat-Video领先于CLIP和RTE-T,而Wan2.1则领先于ATE和RTE-R;两者都比SVD改进了所报告出的所有度量. 大胆和强调地标出最佳和次好的结果。

blocks.en: Figure S4: Training-free camera control across video backbones. Comparisons under a shared SVD backbone show the effect of the guidance method. WorldForge also produces richer scene detail with LongCat-Video, using the same inference-time guidance.
blocks.zh: 图S4:跨视频主干线的无培训相机控制. 在共享SVD主干下进行比较,可以显示指导方法的效果. 世界 Forge还用"长卡特-视频"制作更丰富的场景细节,使用相同的推论时间指导.

blocks.en: Table S4: Training resources and inference efficiency for camera-controlled generation. Our trajectory adapters learn from 50 videos with 1,200 or 1,500 updates. Combining them with released acceleration LoRAs gives speedups of 4.09 × 4.09\times on LongCat and 5.09 × 5.09\times on H3. Times are mean seconds per generated video over 200 test cases for each method, estimated for a single A100 from local runs with native video configurations. Parameter counts refer to the backbones. Training updates exclude backbone pretraining; a dash denotes an unreported total update count.
blocks.zh: 表S4:用于相机控制生成的培训资源和推论效率. 我们的轨迹适配器从50个视频中学习1200或1500个更新. 将它们与释放的加速度LORAs结合,在长猫上给出了4.09× 4.09\时速,在H3上给出了5.09× 5.09\时速. 时间是每个生成的视频的平均秒数,每种方法的测试案例超过200个,从本地的具有本地视频配置的一跑A100估计。 参数计数是指骨干. 培训更新不包括骨干预训;破折表示未报告的更新总数。

blocks.en: For training-free guidance, FLF uses optical flow to compare predicted motion with the rendered reference. Replacing the lightweight Farnebäck estimator [ 74 ] with RAFT allows us to examine whether this selection remains useful with a learned flow model. Figure S5 (a) shows that FLF reduces rendering artifacts and improves generation quality with both estimators.
blocks.zh: 对于无培训指导,FLF使用光学流来将预测运动与给出的参考进行比较. 用RAFT取代轻量级的Farnebäck 估测器 [74] , 使我们能够通过学习的流量模型来检查这一选择是否仍然有用。 图S5(a)显示,FLF减少了渲染文物,并用两个估计器提高了生成质量。

blocks.en: We also construct warped references with VGGT, UniDepth, Mega-SaM, and DepthCrafter to examine the effect of depth estimation (Fig. S5 (b)). Although the estimated geometry differs, the generated views maintain recognizable layouts and plausible surfaces across these reference inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们还与VGGT、UniDepth、Mega-SAM和DepthCrafter一起构建扭曲的参考文献,以审查深度估计的影响(图S5(b))。 虽然估计几何不同,但生成的视图保持了可识别的布局和这些参考投入的可视表面。

blocks.en: Figure S5: Compatibility of training-free guidance with motion and geometry estimators. (a) FLF reduces rendering artifacts with both Farnebäck and RAFT optical flow. (b) Warped references from VGGT, UniDepth, Mega-SaM, and DepthCrafter support coherent scene layouts and plausible surfaces despite differences in their estimated geometry.
blocks.zh: 图S5:无培训指导与运动和几何估计相容. (a) FLF减少Farnebäck和RAFT光学流的渲染文物。 (b) 来自VGGT、Uni Depth、Mega-SAM和DepthCrafter的扭曲引用支持连贯的场景布局和可信的表面,尽管它们的估计几何不同。

blocks.en: 4.4 Training Resources and Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 培训资源和推论效率

blocks.en: Trajectory LoRA learns camera control from 50 videos of 25–93 frames while keeping the pretrained backbone fixed. LongCat uses eight scenes and 1,200 updates, and H3 uses one scene and 1,500 updates. Table S4 compares these training resources and the resulting generation time with the other methods. Warp-as-History also uses a compact source set, deriving four training clips from one source video and expanding them through online clip and direction augmentation.
blocks.zh: 轨迹LORA从25-93帧的50个视频中学习相机控制,同时保持被预先训练的骨干固定. LongCat使用8个场景和1200个更新,而H3则使用1个场景和1500个更新. 表S4比较了这些培训资源以及由此产生的生成时间和其他方法。 Warp-as-History还采用了紧凑的源集,从一个源集视频中取出四个培训剪辑,并通过在线剪辑和方向增强来扩展.

blocks.en: For each backbone, the trained trajectory LoRA can be reused with a released acceleration LoRA, reducing sampling cost without further trajectory training. LongCat [ 71 ] reduces its sampling steps from 40 to 16; H3 uses MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA to reduce sampling from 50 to eight. Visual results are shown in Fig. S6 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个骨干,经过训练的轨迹LORA可以被再利用而释放出加速度LORA,在不进行进一步轨迹训练的情况下降低采样成本. LongCat[71]将其取样步骤从40个减少到16个;H3使用MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA将取样从50个减少到8个. 视觉结果见图. S6.

blocks.en: Figure S6: H3 generation with 50-step and eight-step sampling using the same trajectory LoRA. The accelerated results retain scene layout and object geometry in both examples. Enlargements compare corresponding details.
blocks.zh: 图S6:采用同轨轨道LORA进行50步和8步取样的H3生成. 加速的结果在两个例子中都保留了场景布局和对象几何. 扩大比较相应的细节。

blocks.en: 4.5 Challenging Scenes and Control Limits
blocks.zh: 4.5 挑战行为和控制限制

blocks.en: Figure S7: Camera-control limits under erroneous depth and complex scene dynamics. Distorted face geometry and inconsistencies around moving people show how reference errors remain visible in the generated views. Rows compare training-free WorldForge (top) with TrajectoryCrafter (bottom).
blocks.zh: 图S7:错误深度和复杂场景动态下的相机控制极限. 扭曲的面相几何和移动人周围的不一致显示在所生成的视图中,参考错误如何仍然可见. 行将无训练的世界Forge(上)和TrajectoryCrafter(下)进行比较.

blocks.en: Fast motion, non-rigid motion, and heavy occlusion make reference fusion more difficult. Figure S8 compares generation with and without FLF under these conditions. Selecting the channels for fusion reduces the marked distortions in objects, water, and scene boundaries while retaining the requested viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 快速运动,非刚性运动,和重聚使参考聚变更加困难. 图S8比较了这些条件下的生成量与非FLF. 选择聚变的通道可以减少对象,水和场景边界上所标记的扭曲,同时保留所请求的视角变化.

blocks.en: Figure S8: FLF in training-free generation under fast motion, non-rigid motion, and heavy occlusion. Comparing w/o FLF with w/ FLF shows that selecting channels for reference fusion reduces distortions in objects, water, and scene boundaries while retaining the requested viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 图S8:FLF在快速运动下进行无训练生成,非刚性运动,并有重隐蔽. 将w/o FLF与w/FLF进行比较表明,选择参考聚变的通道可以减少物体、水和场景边界的扭曲,同时保留所要求的视角变化。

blocks.en: Figure S9: Training-free generation of an object-centric 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} orbit from one input image. The final frame of each clip initializes the next segment, extending camera control beyond the original field of view while retaining recognizable scene content.
blocks.zh: 图S9:从一个输入图像中生成一个以物体为中心的360 QQ360 Circ}轨道的无训练生成. 每个剪辑片段的最后帧初始化了下段,将相机控制范围扩大到了原有的视野之外,同时保留了可识别的场景内容.

blocks.en: Figure S10: Camera and content editing with training-free WorldForge. Rendered references support camera freezing and stabilization while retaining scene content. An edited first frame and region masks propagate appearance changes through the video.
blocks.zh: 图S10:带有免费培训的相机和内容编辑. WorldForge. 渲染的参考文献支持相机冻结和稳定,同时保留场景内容. 经编辑的第一帧和区域口罩通过视频传播外观变化.

blocks.en: Severe depth errors can give the rendered reference incorrect geometry, while complex scene dynamics can make its guidance inconsistent across frames. Figure S7 shows these errors in the outputs of training-free WorldForge and TrajectoryCrafter, including distorted faces and inconsistencies around moving people.
blocks.zh: 严重的深度误差可以给被渲染的参考不正确的几何学,而复杂的场景动力学则可以使其指导跨帧不一致. 图S7显示了无培训世界论坛和TrajectoryCrafter产出中的这些错误,包括扭曲的面相和移动人群周围的不一致.

blocks.en: 4.6 Wide-Range Control and Editing
blocks.zh: 4.6 宽程控制和编辑

blocks.en: Figure S11: Additional camera-controlled generation on six held-out DL3DV cases beyond the main figure. Our LongCat and H3 results preserve scene layout and local appearance, while several baseline outputs exhibit distorted boundaries, texture loss, or rendering remnants. LongCat uses the main-table model; H3 uses the eight-step accelerated sampling evaluated in Sec. 4.4 . Inputs and warped references appear on the left, and red boxes identify corresponding enlarged regions.
blocks.zh: 图S11:除主图外,还有6个被搁置的DL3DV的相机控制生成. 我们的LongCat和H3结果保持了场景布局和当地外观,而若干基线产出显示出扭曲的边界、纹理损失或使残余物产生。 LongCat采用主表型;H3采用Sec评价的八步加速采样. 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 左侧有输入和被扭曲的参考文献,红框显示相应的扩大区域。

blocks.en: To follow paths with large camera rotations, we generate successive clips and use the final frame of each clip to initialize the next. Figure S9 shows an object-centric 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} orbit generated from one input image. The clips retain recognizable scene content as the camera moves beyond the original field of view.

blocks.en: The same rendered-reference guidance also supports camera freezing and stabilization (Fig. S10 ). For content editing, we segment the target region in each frame and edit its appearance in the first frame. This edited frame and the region masks guide the change through the video, while the rendered reference specifies the viewpoint. For an object absent from the source video, a bounding box specifies where it should be added.
blocks.zh: 同样的渲染参考指南也支持相机被冻结和稳定(图S10. 为了进行内容编辑,我们将每个帧中的目标区域分出,并编辑第一个帧中的外观. 这个经编辑的相框和区域口罩通过视频引导变化,而给出的参考则指定了观点. 对于源视频中缺失的对象,一个边框指定了应当添加在何处.

blocks.zh: 5 额外视觉比较

blocks.en: Figure S11 adds six held-out DL3DV cases to the learned-control comparison. Indoor layouts, outdoor structures, and finely textured objects allow us to examine how viewpoint changes affect structural boundaries, repeated patterns, and surface detail. Our LongCat and H3 results preserve scene layout and local appearance, while several baseline outputs contain distorted boundaries, texture loss, or rendering remnants.
blocks.zh: 图S11在学习控制比较中增加了6个被搁置的DL3DV案例. 室内布局,户外结构,以及精细的纹理化的物体,使我们能够研究观点的变化如何影响结构界限,重复的规律,以及地表细节. 我们的LongCat和H3结果保持了场景布局和局部外观,而若干基线产出包含扭曲的边界、纹理损失或产生残余。
